name: Online business idea teardowns
customer: First-time founders deciding whether to pursue a business idea, likely pre-launch and paying out of pocket
problem: I want a quick, cheap, trustworthy read on my idea's market so I can decide go or no-go before investing time and money.

revenue_model.notes: Pay per report; each report is a one-page readout of competitors, pricing, customers and gaps. No tiers or bundles stated.

category: Business idea validation / market research reports

search_queries.query: best business idea validation tools for founders
AI market research report for startup idea
how to validate a business idea yourself competitor research template
first time founder validate startup idea before building reddit
market research tool reviews solo founders complaints
new business applications per year statistics
business idea validation search interest trend

ambiguities.issue: Price is a $5–10 range with no rule for what sets the price within it.
ambiguities.assumption: Treat as a single report priced in the $5–10 band; research will compare against per-report and subscription alternatives.

ambiguities.issue: First-time founders could mean tech startup founders or anyone starting a small local business, which changes competitors and channels.
ambiguities.assumption: Include both startup and small-business founders; research notes which segment alternatives target.

ambiguities.issue: One-time billing per report may not fit founders who evaluate several ideas, but repeat purchase is not addressed.
ambiguities.assumption: Assume pay-per-report with no bundles; research will check whether competitors use bundles or subscriptions.
